svg.title: OmniRoute release rail: v3.8.50 to v3.8.54 prepare, v3.8.55 to v3.8.59 validate, then v3.9.0 LTS.
svg.desc: A horizontal rail. The prepare window (v3.8.50 to v3.8.54) is a solid line, the validation window (v3.8.55 to v3.8.59, fixes, docs, translations and provider updates only) is a dashed line, and it ends at a pulsing v3.9.0 LTS node. A dot travels slowly along the rail from left to right. There is no v3.8.60.
svg.text: fixes, docs, translations and provider updates only
There is no v3.8.60. After v3.8.59 the next release is v3.9.0, the long-term support line.
